== Summary ==
'''CardMaker recreation''' of [[Impressive, Most Impressive (V) (Virtual Block 2) (Errata)]] (<code>1220_145</code>, Virtual Block 2 slip 145), showing the '''PC-E1''' game text. No published image shows this text: the Virtual Block 2 release-sheet slip ([[:File:VB2-145-Impressive_Most_Impressive.png]]) and the Players Committee card image ([[:File:VB2-L-impressivemostimpressive-pre.gif]]) both show the original text of [[Impressive, Most Impressive (V) (Virtual Block 2)]].

* '''Text source:''' Players Committee website card list (VBlock2Type), as captured [https://web.archive.org/web/20120721064711/http://www.starwarsccg.org:80/cardlists/VBlock2Type.html 2012-07-21] and [https://web.archive.org/web/20130111142857/http://www.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/VBlock2Type.html 2013-01-11] (Internet Archive). The card list drops icons; the icons are those of the printed slip, drawn as icons. Published typos are kept as printed.
* '''PC-E1 text:''' “Cancel All Too Easy, Stunning Leader (where your Jedi participating), Imperial Barrier (targeting your Jedi), or You Are Beaten (except when canceling Uncontrollable Fury). (Immune to Sense.) OR Once per game, if opponent just initiated a battle, you may take the first weapons segment action.”
* '''Made:''' 8 November 2026 with the SWCCG CardMaker (https://swccg.com/cardmaker/, repo billbisco/swccg-cardmaker, STANDARD rev 71) from the card's own Virtual Legacy card (<code>1220_145</code>: Decipher art, frame, title, lore, icons, Virtual Block 2 set mark, slip number 145 as on the Players Committee card image, copyright line) with the PC-E1 game text. Holotable size, 745 × 1039. Rebuild spec: <code>VB2-145-Impressive_Most_Impressive-PC-E1-cardmaker.png.spec.json</code> in the batch B05 run folder.
* '''Not an official image.''' Card art and design © Lucasfilm Ltd. and Decipher Inc.; virtual card text by the Star Wars CCG Players Committee.
